question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. It was raining heavily. || II. We decided to stay indoors. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Pahla sentence karan (cause) bata raha hai aur doosra uska parinam (effect). Aise case mein 'Therefore' (isliye) ka use karte hain. Combined: It was raining heavily, therefore we decided to stay indoors.
trick: Cause aur Effect wale relation mein hamesha 'Therefore', 'So' ya 'Hence' ka use hota hai.
tip: Result batane wale connectors par dhyan dein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He is very rich. || II. He is quite unhappy. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan dono sentences ek doosre ke opposite (contrast) hain. Paisa hone ke baad bhi wah dukhi hai. Isliye 'Yet' (phir bhi) aayega. Combined: He is very rich, yet he is quite unhappy.
trick: Jab do baatein opposite result dikhayein, toh 'Yet', 'But' ya 'Still' lagate hain.
tip: Opposite ideas humesha contrast connectors lete hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You must walk faster. || II. You will miss the train. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Ek sentence shart (condition) bata raha hai aur doosra uska nuksan. Aise mein 'Otherwise' (anyatha / varna) ka use hota hai. Combined: You must walk faster, otherwise you will miss the train.
trick: Jab koi warning ya condition di ho jiska result negative ho, wahan 'Otherwise' aata hai.
tip: 'Varna' ka sense aane par 'Otherwise' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. She loves reading fiction books. || II. Her brother prefers playing outdoor games. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan do alag-alag logon ki pasand ko compare kiya ja raha hai jo ki opposite hain. Isliye 'Whereas' (jabki) use hoga. Combined: She loves reading fiction books whereas her brother prefers playing outdoor games.
trick: Jab do subjects ke beech comparison aur contrast dono ho, wahan 'Whereas' best hota hai.
tip: 'Jabki' ka meaning nikalne par 'Whereas' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. Rahul studied diligently all night. || II. He scored the highest marks in his class. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Padhai karna karan hai aur highest marks aana uska result hai. Result batane ke liye 'So' (isliye) ka use hota hai. Combined: Rahul studied diligently all night, so he scored the highest marks in his class.
trick: Action ka direct result dikhane ke liye 'So' sabse simple aur common connector hai.
tip: Result (parinam) ke liye hamesha 'So' use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The new laptop is very expensive. || II. It consumes a lot of battery power. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Dono sentences mein laptop ki negative baatein add ki ja rahi hain. Extra information jodne ke liye 'Moreover' (iske alawa) use karte hain. Combined: The new laptop is very expensive; moreover, it consumes a lot of battery power.
trick: Jab ek hi jaisi information (dono positive ya dono negative) jodna ho, toh 'Moreover' lagayein.
tip: Same tone wale sentences mein addition connector use hota hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. I will not attend the function. || II. You come with me. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan ek strong condition hai ki 'jab tak' tum nahi aaoge, main nahi jaunga. Iske liye 'Unless' (jab tak ki nahi) use hota hai. Combined: I will not attend the function unless you come with me.
trick: Sentence mein 'jab tak' aur negative meaning chhipa ho toh 'Unless' sabse sahi option hai.
tip: 'Unless' khud negative hai, iske baad 'not' nahi aata.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The teacher forgave the student. || II. He apologized for his mistake genuinely. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Teacher ne maaf kyun kiya? Kyunki usne maafi maangi. Doosra sentence karan bata raha hai, isliye 'Because' (kyunki) aayega. Combined: The teacher forgave the student because he apologized for his mistake genuinely.
trick: Jab second sentence mein 'kyunki' ka answer mile, toh 'Because' bina soche select karein.
tip: Reason batane wale clause ke pehle 'Because' lagta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. We can go to watch a movie. || II. We can have dinner at a restaurant. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Dono sentences mein se kisi ek option ko chunne ki baat ho rahi hai. Choice batane ke liye 'Or' (ya) ka use karte hain. Combined: We can go to watch a movie or have dinner at a restaurant.
trick: Jahan par do options (choices) diye ho, wahan humesha 'Or' ya 'Either...or' use hota hai.
tip: Choices dikhane ke liye 'Or' sabse best hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The local train was late. || II. We managed to reach the station on time. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Train late hone ke baad bhi time par pahunchna ek unexpected result hai (contrast). Aise case mein 'Although' (halanki) use karte hain. Combined: Although the local train was late, we managed to reach the station on time.
trick: Halanki (Although) se sentence tab judta hai jab action ke against result nikal raha ho.
tip: Unexpected result aaye toh 'Although' ka use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He lost his mobile phone in the market. || II. He lost his car keys. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan ek hi person ke do same type ke actions (kuch khona) ko joda ja raha hai. Aise addition ke liye 'And' (aur) use hota hai. Combined: He lost his mobile phone and his car keys in the market.
trick: Jab do similar actions ya nouns ko directly jodna ho, toh 'And' ka use karte hain.
tip: Similar baaton ko jodte waqt 'And' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. She was feeling very sick today. || II. She went to see the doctor in the evening. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Bimar hona karan (reason) hai aur doctor ke paas jana uska direct natija (result) hai. Isliye 'Hence' (is karan se) use hoga. Combined: She was feeling very sick today, hence she went to see the doctor in the evening.
trick: 'Hence' ka use 'Therefore' ki tarah hota hai, jab cause ke baad uska logical conclusion aaye.
tip: Logical conclusion batane ke liye 'Hence' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The cricket match was cancelled entirely. || II. It was raining heavily since morning. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Match cancel hone ka reason baarish hai. Jab hum karan batate hain toh 'As' (kyunki / jaise ki) ka use kar sakte hain. Combined: The cricket match was cancelled entirely as it was raining heavily since morning.
trick: 'Because' aur 'As' dono reason dikhate hain. Options mein 'Because' na ho toh 'As' chunein.
tip: 'As' yahan reason (kyunki) ka kaam kar raha hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. Amit is a talented classical singer. || II. He plays the acoustic guitar very well. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Amit ki do achhi qualities ko ek sath add kiya ja raha hai. Extra positive point batane ke liye 'Furthermore' (iske alawa) ka use hota hai. Combined: Amit is a talented classical singer; furthermore, he plays the acoustic guitar very well.
trick: Kisi ki tareef mein ek aur sentence jodne ke liye 'Furthermore' ya 'Moreover' lagate hain.
tip: Extra information jodne ke liye 'Furthermore' use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. I called him several times yesterday. || II. He did not answer the phone. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Call karna aur answer na milna, dono baatein ek doosre ke opposite hain (contrast). Isliye simple contrast dikhane ke liye 'But' (lekin) aayega. Combined: I called him several times yesterday, but he did not answer the phone.
trick: Jab expectation ke opposite kuch ho jaye, wahan sabse basic connector 'But' use hota hai.
tip: 'Lekin' ya 'parantu' ka sense ho toh 'But' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You must start your journey early. || II. You will definitely miss the morning flight. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Jaldi nikalne ki warning di ja rahi hai, varna flight miss ho jayegi. Aise warning/condition mein 'Or else' (varna) use karte hain. Combined: You must start your journey early, or else you will definitely miss the morning flight.
trick: 'Or else' ka meaning 'Otherwise' jaisa hi hota hai. Dono negative consequences se pehle aate hain.
tip: Warning aur nuksan dikhane ke liye 'Or else' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He ran as fast as he could. || II. He wanted to catch the departing train. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Usne tez daud lagayi jiska uddeshya (purpose) train pakadna tha. Purpose batane ke liye 'So that' (taaki) lagate hain. Combined: He ran as fast as he could so that he could catch the departing train.
trick: Jab action ke piche ka maqsad (taaki) batana ho, toh aankh band karke 'So that' tick karein.
tip: 'Taaki' ka arth aane par 'So that' ka chunav karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The food at the party was delicious. || II. The catering service was terribly slow. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Khana achha tha (positive), lekin service kharab thi (negative). Jab directly ek dusri baat ko kaate toh 'However' (halanki / phir bhi) use karte hain. Combined: The food at the party was delicious; however, the catering service was terribly slow.
trick: Ek positive aur ek negative sentence ke beech mein humesha 'However' ya 'But' lagta hai.
tip: Contrast batane ke liye 'However' ka use best hota hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He is not studying for his upcoming exams. || II. He is playing video games on his computer. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Wah padhai karne ki bajaye game khel raha hai. Ek action ko chhodkar doosra action karne par 'Instead' (ke bajaye) ka use hota hai. Combined: He is not studying for his exams; instead, he is playing video games on his computer.
trick: Jab sentence 'A nahi kar raha, balki B kar raha hai' ka sense de, toh 'Instead' chunein.
tip: 'Balki' ya 'ke bajaye' ke liye 'Instead' use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. She has five years of corporate experience. || II. She was not selected for the manager role. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Experience hone ke bawajood select na hona aashcharya ki baat hai (strong contrast). Yahan 'Nevertheless' (phir bhi / ke bawajood) aayega. Combined: She has five years of corporate experience; nevertheless, she was not selected for the manager role.
trick: 'Nevertheless' ka meaning 'In spite of that' hota hai. Aise contrast jahan strong opposition ho, wahan use karein.
tip: Strong contrast mein 'Nevertheless' ka prayog kijiye.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He worked very hard for the interview. || II. He could not get the job. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Pahle sentence mein mehnat ki baat hai aur doosre mein failure ki. Yeh opposite ideas hain. Isliye 'Yet' (phir bhi) ka use hoga. Combined: He worked very hard for the interview, yet he could not get the job.
trick: Mehnat aur failure jaise opposite statements ko jodney ke liye 'Yet' ya 'But' use karein.
tip: Opposite results ke liye hamesha contrast connector chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. She went to the supermarket. || II. She bought some fresh vegetables. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan do lagatar hone wale normal actions bataye gaye hain. Inko jodney ke liye simple addition connector 'And' (aur) aayega. Combined: She went to the supermarket and bought some fresh vegetables.
trick: Jab do sentences mein series of action ho (ek ke baad ek kaam), toh 'And' lagate hain.
tip: Simple addition ke liye 'And' sabse best hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The main highway was blocked due to an accident. || II. We had to take a detour through the village. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Road block hona karan (cause) hai aur detour lena uska parinam (effect). Result batane ke liye 'Therefore' (isliye) use karte hain. Combined: The main highway was blocked due to an accident, therefore we had to take a detour through the village.
trick: Karan aur natija (cause-effect) dikhane wale sentences mein 'Therefore' ya 'So' lagta hai.
tip: Result ya parinam dikhane ke liye 'Therefore' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You must pay the traffic fine by tomorrow. || II. Your driving license will be suspended. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Ek shart (fine bharna) aur uska nuksan (license suspend hona) diya hai. Aise warning ke liye 'Otherwise' (varna) aayega. Combined: You must pay the traffic fine by tomorrow, otherwise your driving license will be suspended.
trick: Jab 'karo varna nuksan hoga' ka sense aaye, toh turant 'Otherwise' tick karein.
tip: 'Varna' ya 'nahi toh' ke liye 'Otherwise' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The manager canceled the team meeting. || II. Many employees were on leave today. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Meeting cancel hone ka reason doosre sentence mein diya hai ki log chhutti par the. Reason batane ke liye 'Because' (kyunki) aayega. Combined: The manager canceled the team meeting because many employees were on leave today.
trick: Jab second part mein 'kyunki' ka jawab mile, wahan 'Because' ya 'Since' use hota hai.
tip: Reason (karan) batane wale clauses ke sath 'Because' use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You can submit the assignment in a physical folder. || II. You can upload it on the student portal. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan students ko assignment submit karne ke do alag options (choices) diye gaye hain. Choice ke liye 'Or' (ya) aayega. Combined: You can submit the assignment in a physical folder or upload it on the student portal.
trick: Jab do alag-alag raste ya options diye ho, toh unhe jodney ke liye 'Or' lagate hain.
tip: Vikalp (choices) dikhane ke liye 'Or' ka use hota hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The hotel room was extremely dirty. || II. The room service was exceptionally good. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Room ganda tha (negative), par service achhi thi (positive). Ek negative aur ek positive ko jodney ke liye 'However' (phir bhi) aayega. Combined: The hotel room was extremely dirty; however, the room service was exceptionally good.
trick: Jab do contradictory baatein (ek buri, ek achhi) aamne-samne ho, wahan 'However' aata hai.
tip: Opposite points ko compare karne ke liye 'However' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He carefully packed all the fragile items. || II. They would not break during the shifting process. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Saman pack karne ke piche ek purpose (uddeshya) tha ki wo toote nahi. Purpose dikhane ke liye 'So that' (taaki) lagate hain. Combined: He carefully packed all the fragile items so that they would not break during the shifting process.
trick: Jab koi kaam kisi khas natije ko paane ya rokne ke liye ho (taaki), wahan 'So that' aata hai.
tip: 'Taaki' ka meaning banne par 'So that' use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. She usually prefers drinking black tea. || II. Her younger sister loves drinking cold coffee. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Do logon ki alag-alag pasand ko compare kiya ja raha hai. Aise contrast wale comparison ke liye 'Whereas' (jabki) use hota hai. Combined: She usually prefers drinking black tea whereas her younger sister loves drinking cold coffee.
trick: Jab do subjects ki alag aadat ya pasand batani ho, toh 'Whereas' ya 'While' ka prayog karein.
tip: Jabki (contrast comparison) ke sense mein 'Whereas' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The company's profits declined this year. || II. They decided to give bonuses to all employees. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Profit girne ke baad bhi bonus dena ek hairani wali baat hai (strong contrast). Yahan 'Nevertheless' (phir bhi/iske bawajood) aayega. Combined: The company's profits declined this year; nevertheless, they decided to give bonuses to all employees.
trick: Strong contrast ya in-spite-of wale meaning ke liye 'Nevertheless' ek excellent option hai.
tip: Unexpected actions ko jodney ke liye 'Nevertheless' ka use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The concert tickets were sold out within minutes. || II. We managed to buy two tickets from a reseller. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Ticket bik chuke the, lekin unko ticket mil gaye. Yeh simple contrast hai jise 'But' (lekin) se joda jayega. Combined: The concert tickets were sold out within minutes, but we managed to buy two tickets from a reseller.
trick: Bich mein 'lekin' ka sense aaye toh bina soche 'But' tick karein. 'Although' sentence ke start mein better lagta hai.
tip: Lekin/Parantu ke sense ke liye 'But' sabse aasan connector hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The candidate lacks formal marketing experience. || II. He is very enthusiastic and willing to learn. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Ek taraf experience nahi hai (weakness), doosri taraf josh hai (strength). Alag pahlu dikhane ke liye 'On the other hand' (doosri taraf) use karte hain. Combined: The candidate lacks formal marketing experience; on the other hand, he is very enthusiastic and willing to learn.
trick: Ek hi situation ke do alag-alag aspects (positive aur negative) batane ke liye 'On the other hand' best hai.
tip: 'Doosri taraf' ka arth batane ke liye ise chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. They must improve their product quality. || II. They will lose all their loyal customers. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Quality improve karne ki warning hai, nahi toh customer chale jayenge. 'Nahi toh/varna' ke liye 'Or else' aayega. Combined: They must improve their product quality, or else they will lose all their loyal customers.
trick: Warning wale sentences mein jahan aage nuksan dikhaya ho, wahan 'Or else' ya 'Otherwise' aata hai.
tip: Warning ke liye 'Or else' ka prayog karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The museum is famous for its ancient artifacts. || II. It has a beautiful botanical garden. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Museum ki do achhi cheezon (artifacts aur garden) ko joda ja raha hai. Extra information add karne ke liye 'Furthermore' (iske alawa) use hota hai. Combined: The museum is famous for its ancient artifacts; furthermore, it has a beautiful botanical garden.
trick: Jab do positive (ya dono negative) facts ek sath add karne ho toh 'Furthermore' ya 'Moreover' lagate hain.
tip: Information add karne ke liye 'Furthermore' ka use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. I cannot grant you a leave this week. || II. We are facing a severe shortage of staff. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Chhutti na milne ka karan staff ki kami hai. Karan batane ke liye 'Since' (kyunki / chuki) ka use hota hai. Combined: I cannot grant you a leave this week since we are facing a severe shortage of staff.
trick: 'Because', 'As', aur 'Since' teeno reason (karan) batane ke kaam aate hain. Options mein 'Since' sahi fit hai.
tip: Karan batane ke liye 'Since' ek acha vikalp hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You will not be allowed inside the examination hall. || II. You show your valid admit card. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan strict condition hai ki 'jab tak' admit card nahi dikhaoge, entry nahi milegi. Iske liye 'Unless' (jab tak ki nahi) aayega. Combined: You will not be allowed inside the examination hall unless you show your valid admit card.
trick: Sentence mein 'jab tak' ka sense aur ek clause ka negative hona 'Unless' ki nishani hai.
tip: Condition (shart) ke liye 'Unless' ka use kiya jata hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The flight was delayed by over three hours. || II. The terrible weather conditions in the city. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Flight delay hone ka karan kharab mausam hai. 'Ke karan' (reason) batane ke liye 'Due to' aayega. Dhyan rahe, doosra part noun phrase hai. Combined: The flight was delayed by over three hours due to the terrible weather conditions in the city.
trick: Jab reason ek sentence na hokar noun phrase ho (the terrible weather), tab 'Because of' ya 'Due to' lagta hai.
tip: Noun phrase se pehle reason ke liye 'Due to' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He continued to play the football match. || II. He had a severe pain in his ankle. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Dard hone ke baad bhi match khelna ek strong contrast hai. 'Bhale hi' ya 'halanki' ke liye 'Even though' use hoga. Combined: He continued to play the football match even though he had a severe pain in his ankle.
trick: Jab koi action uske physical/logical barrier ke bawajood ho raha ho, tab 'Even though' use karte hain.
tip: 'Bhale hi' ke sense mein 'Even though' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. We started our preparation very late. || II. We managed to cover the entire syllabus. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Late shuru karne par bhi syllabus cover kar lena contrast dikhata hai. 'Phir bhi' ke liye 'Still' aayega. Combined: We started our preparation very late, still we managed to cover the entire syllabus.
trick: Dono actions ka opposite result dikhane ke liye 'Still' (phir bhi) ek simple aur effective connector hai.
tip: 'Phir bhi' ka sense ho toh 'Still' ka chayan karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You should follow a strict diet plan. || II. You will not be able to lose weight. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Diet plan follow karne ki shart hai, nahi toh wajan kam nahi hoga. Aise warning/condition ke liye 'Otherwise' (varna) aayega. Combined: You should follow a strict diet plan, otherwise you will not be able to lose weight.
trick: 'Karo varna ye nuksan hoga' wale sentences mein hamesha 'Otherwise' ya 'Or else' use karein.
tip: 'Nahi toh' ke arth ke liye 'Otherwise' best hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The restaurant offers delicious Chinese food. || II. It provides excellent customer service. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Dono sentences mein restaurant ki positive quality batayi gayi hai. Ek jaisi information add karne ke liye 'Moreover' (iske alawa) use karte hain. Combined: The restaurant offers delicious Chinese food; moreover, it provides excellent customer service.
trick: Jab do positive ya similar points ek sath rakhne ho, tab 'Moreover' ka use hota hai.
tip: Extra positive information ke liye 'Moreover' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You need to practice typing every day. || II. You will not clear the skill test. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Typing practice karna ek shart (condition) hai, jiska nuksan doosre sentence mein diya hai. Aisi warning ke liye 'Otherwise' (varna) use hoga. Combined: You need to practice typing every day, otherwise you will not clear the skill test.
trick: 'Karo varna fail ho jaoge' wale sentences mein hamesha 'Otherwise' ya 'Or else' aata hai.
tip: Warning ya condition wale case mein 'Otherwise' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The bridge is under heavy construction. || II. All heavy vehicles are diverted. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Bridge ka construction chalna karan (cause) hai aur vehicles ko divert karna uska parinam (effect). Result ke liye 'Consequently' (parinam swaroop) aayega. Combined: The bridge is under heavy construction; consequently, all heavy vehicles are diverted.
trick: Jab ek action ka direct result doosra action ho, tab 'Consequently' ya 'Therefore' chunein.
tip: Result dikhane wale connectors par focus karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The smartphone has amazing features. || II. Its battery life is very poor. || Question: Which connector can be used?

trick: Jab kisi cheez ka look aur uski reality ek doosre ke opposite hon, toh 'Yet' ya 'But' use karein.
tip: Surprising opposite result ke liye 'Yet' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. You can watch the documentary on television. || II. You can stream it online on your smartphone. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan documentary dekhne ke do alag-alag tarike (options) bataye gaye hain. Choice dene ke liye 'Or' (ya) ka prayog hoga. Combined: You can watch the documentary on television or stream it online on your smartphone.
trick: Jab bhi do vikalp (choices) diye jayein ki 'ye karo ya wo', toh 'Or' lagana sabse sahi hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. trick: Jab koi action kisi khas lakshya (goal/taaki) ko paane ke liye kiya jaye, wahan 'So that' aata hai.
tip: Uddeshya ya goal dikhane ke liye 'So that' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. My mother was cooking dinner in the kitchen. || II. I was finishing my math homework. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Yahan do kaam ek hi samay par (simultaneously) ho rahe hain. Ek sath chalne wale actions ko jodney ke liye 'While' (jis dauran) aayega. Combined: My mother was cooking dinner in the kitchen while I was finishing my math homework.
trick: Jab do continuous tense (was/were + ing) wale sentence ek sath ho, toh unhe 'While' se joda jata hai.
tip: Ek hi samay par hone wale kaamo ke liye 'While' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. Cotton clothes are very comfortable in summer. || II. Synthetic clothes cause excessive sweating. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Do alag-alag kapdon ki qualities ko compare kiya ja raha hai jo ek doosre ke opposite hain. Is comparison ke liye 'Whereas' (jabki) aayega. Combined: Cotton clothes are very comfortable in summer whereas synthetic clothes cause excessive sweating.
trick: Jab do alag subjects ke beech contrast aur comparison dono ho, toh wahan 'Whereas' use karte hain.
tip: 'Jabki' ka sense nikalne par 'Whereas' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. He ran very fast towards the bus stop. || II. He missed the morning bus. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Tez bhagna aur phir bhi bus miss kar dena ek sidha contrast hai. Is simple contrast ko jodney ke liye 'But' (lekin) aayega. Combined: He ran very fast towards the bus stop, but he missed the morning bus.
trick: Jab mehnat ke bawajood success na mile, toh usko 'But' ya 'Yet' se jodte hain.
tip: 'Lekin' ya 'parantu' ke liye 'But' sabse behtar hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The roads are heavily flooded due to rain. || II. The school administration has declared a holiday. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Holiday declare hone ka karan roads par paani bharna hai. Karan (reason) batane ke liye 'Because' ki tarah 'Since' (kyunki / chuki) aayega. Combined: Since the roads are heavily flooded due to rain, the school administration has declared a holiday.
trick: 'Since' aur 'As' dono hi 'Because' ke achhe alternatives hain. Jab karan dikhana ho toh inko chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. trick: Jab list mein positive ya negative features badhane ho, toh 'Furthermore' ya 'Moreover' lagate hain.
tip: Extra points add karne ke liye 'Furthermore' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. The bread was completely stale and hard. || II. We threw it in the dustbin immediately. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Bread ka kharab hona karan hai aur usko dustbin mein phekna uska natija (result). Result dikhane ke liye 'So' (isliye) aayega. Combined: The bread was completely stale and hard, so we threw it in the dustbin immediately.
trick: Jab action uske pehle diye gaye karan ki wajah se liya jaye, toh seedha 'So' lagayein.
tip: Direct result batane ke liye 'So' ka use karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. Do not sign the final business contract. || II. You read all the terms and conditions carefully. || Question: Which connector can be used?
explanation: Sign na karne ki ek time-based shart hai ki 'jab tak' terms na padh lo. Aisi limit set karne ke liye 'Until' (jab tak ki nahi) aayega. Combined: Do not sign the final business contract until you read all the terms and conditions carefully.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. trick: Jab kisi physical problem ya mushkil ke bawajood kaam pura ho, wahan 'Even though' ka effect sabse strong hota hai.
tip: 'Bhale hi' ke sense mein 'Even though' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. trick: 'Hence' ka use formal English mein 'Therefore' ki jagah kiya jata hai jab cause and effect dikhana ho.
tip: Logical natija batane ke liye 'Hence' chunein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I. question: Direction: Select the most appropriate connector from the options to combine the given sentences into a single meaningful sentence without changing its original meaning. || I.
